quarterly_data.quarter: VAT Group press release: Highest QUarterly order intake and sales ever as strong AI (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 release figures not stated on the call: record order intake of CHF 697 million (696.6), up 39% sequentially and 193% year on year (35% and 188% at constant currency), reflecting the build-out of both leading-edge logic and memory capacity; order backlog CHF 979.5 million, up 51% sequentially. Valves orders CHF 595.7 million (Semiconductors CHF 538.2 million, Advanced Industrials CHF 57.4 million) and Valves backlog CHF 872.0 million; Global Service orders CHF 101.0 million and backlog CHF 107.5 million. Nine months 2026: orders CHF 1,553.0 million (+113.5%), net sales CHF 888.3 million (+8.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 orders CHF 697 million (+39% QoQ, +193% YoY); 9M orders CHF 1,553.0 million; 9M sales CHF 888.3 million

quarterly_data.quarter: VAT Group press release: Highest QUarterly order intake and sales ever as strong AI (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Demand drivers (release): the company says the extension of semiconductor ordering windows is 'partly driven by anticipated price increases or concerns over availability going forward'. In Advanced Industrials, ultra-high-vacuum coating applications with consumer-electronics exposure performed well, while orders for valves in research applications are notably lower after funding cuts. The company names exceptionally high hyperscaler data-center capex and the onset of high-volume Gate All Around (GAA) production as the triggers of the advanced logic and memory supply-demand imbalance.
